name: comp-412

frames.best_why: The whole capsule, all four faces and the bold 60K+ sit clear of the cursor.

tagline: A bordered capsule stacks four tiny faces beside a bold trust count.
summary: A slim outlined pill holding four overlapping miniature portraits and the line Trusted by 60K+ developers, with the figure set in bright white.
appearance: A low rounded capsule with a hairline border and soft shadow rests on black. Inside, four 20px circular faces overlap tightly at the left, then a dim grey sentence follows with 60K+ picked out in bold near-white.
behaviour: Static: the capsule, faces and wording never move or respond. Only the recording cursor drifts past underneath.
demo_content: Four stock portraits and the sentence Trusted by 60K+ developers.
search_phrases: trusted by thousands with little faces
social proof chip with user count
tiny profile pictures beside a number
show how many customers trust us
small faces next to bold number
use_when: A compact strip of social proof directly below a hero or beside a signup button.
avoid_when: When the number must be truthful: the 60K+ figure and portrait files are fixed in the source.
customise: The sentence, its bold figure and the four portrait files are written inside; changing any means editing the file. The capsule's border, padding and shadow are classes.
weight_why: Four tiny images, a line of text and a border; nothing runs or loops.

a11y.note: Each portrait has alt text and the claim is real selectable text, so it reads cleanly; nothing here is interactive.

issues: The trust count is hardcoded, so the claim can drift from the real userbase.
polish_why: Neat capsule with balanced spacing, but a very familiar social proof strip with stock faces.
